<!--
Example demographics data model (YAML) for the data-model slide.
Pulled into the deck with an include shortcode pointing at this file.
code-line-numbers drives the incremental highlight build (names / keys /
types / type-specific values).
-->
```{.yaml code-line-numbers="1,5,8,14,17|2|3,6,9,15,18|4,7,10,16,19,20,21,22|11-13"}
unique_subject_id:
  key: true
  data_type: character
  character_pattern: ^[A-Z0-9-]+-\d+-\d+$
site_id:
  data_type: character
  character_pattern: ^\d+$
baseline_height_cm:
  data_type: numeric
  numeric_units: centimeter
  terms:
    loinc: 8302-2
    snomed: C0005890
diagnosis_date:
  data_type: Date
  date_format: "%Y-%m-%d"
actual_arm:
  data_type: factor
  factor_allowed_values:
    - Arm A
    - Arm B
    - Arm C
```
